This '''unidentified [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]]''' was a criminal who was active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> he helped the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] capture the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. During the mission, this Nikto served as the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of Cad Bane's [[RGC-16 airspeeder/Legends|RGC-16 airspeeder]]. He ferried Cad Bane, the bounty hunter's [[Techno-service droid/Legends|techno-service droid]] [[Todo 360/Legends|Todo 360]], and the [[Assassin droid/Legends|Assassin droid]] [[HELIOS-3E/Legends|HELIOS-3E]] to their [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] hideout. He later took back the captured droids by speeder.
